story.title: Paytm Rules Out NBFC Licence Plans, Stays Silent on Wallet Revival as It Pivots to Agentic AI Strategy
story.summary: Paytm has publicly ruled out applying for a Non-Banking Financial Company licence, distancing itself from rivals pushing deeper into lending, while remaining silent on whether it will seek revival of its payments wallet licence following the RBI's crackdown on its payments bank arm. The company's Q4 FY26 earnings call instead indicated a strategic pivot toward agentic AI capabilities and wealthtech services as its primary growth engines. This positions Paytm as an AI-first fintech platform rather than a traditional financial services provider.
